note: The manager owns this file. Structured on purpose: the previous loop kept its state as a prose header that degenerated into a run-on paragraph. Every dimension has a byte AND a count cap, enforced by rotate-ledger.mjs.

menu.note: The menu is DATA, not prose in a skill file, so the manager can extend it (ladder rung 3). Adding a domain or a kind here is a legitimate strategic move.

kinds.name: New element
kinds.what: a thing the town did not contain

kinds.name: New CA rule
kinds.what: a new per-cell rule that makes the grid evolve

kinds.name: Deepen
kinds.what: make an existing system richer, or wire two together

kinds.name: Connect
kinds.what: link two places or systems that ignore each other

kinds.name: Polish
kinds.what: make what is there read better; add nothing

kinds.name: Interaction/UX
kinds.what: how you read, poke or navigate the diorama

kinds.name: Scale/World
kinds.what: change the size, span or time of the world itself

kinds.name: Harness
kinds.what: the loop's own instruments — gates, probes, runlog, stats. Changes nothing a viewer sees, and does NOT count toward a domain's balance

coverage.note: domain -> kind -> iteration numbers. Pre-loop work (CHANGELOG iterations 1-31, hand-driven) is recorded as `pre` so the manager knows the ground it stands on.

skyxpolish.why: 6 polish entries, more than any other cell, on the best-drawn system in the town. The lowest-yield move available. Sky work from here is Deepen or Connect.

inventory.note: What the town ALREADY contains, as nouns plus the symbols and probes a brief must name. One line per system, <=300 B, enforced by rotate-ledger.mjs. Measurements and histories belong in the ledger. Read before you build.
courtyard: walled garden with a bed ring, four arch entrances (2 TUNNEL, 2 SLOT), benches, desire paths from foot wear (wear[]), daisies, ivy, a pre-dawn sweeper, one linden (drawTree, CX/CY); planting CA — 11 species, bloom stages, seeding, crowding, dieback; rain speeds growth

the beds read the YEAR — growF()/dieF() off warmth, lawn health in groundCol; bloomCap() a RAMP over warmth (BLOOM_LO 0.12 → BLOOM_HI 0.50 = anchor), a CEILING dithered per courtyard CELL / allotment PLOT by capStep() (hash y+53). probes/beds-year.mjs, bloom-cap.mjs

snow knows the paths — snowAt() takes 1-SNOW_WEAR*max(wear/SNOW_WEAR_AT, trod[]); trod[] cut by feet on GRASS and by any a.broom agent's cell, buried by fresh fall (SNOW_BURY), zeroed when cover melts out. probes/snow-wear.mjs
lane: kiosk, pavement cafe with claimable tables, awnings, washing lines, planters, lamps, benches; market every 4th day, three stalls, marketRaise(i) stages each up/down as clamps on one 0..1
washing comes in before the rain — per-garment thresholds on weatherComing(), plus a dusk ramp
the working day hangs off the SUN — kioskOpen/marketOpen/marketClose/marketRaise/sweeper are offsets from sunUp/sunDown; MK_MIN_SPAN floors winter, MK_EARLIEST holds summer. probes/working-day.mjs

the stalls sell what the plots grew — produce[] written only by harvestPlot(); stockMarket() latches it into mkShelf per market day; marketRaise(i) gates on mkTrades(i) (MK_NEED): a thin year raises fewer stalls. probes/market-year.mjs

the town's ONE evening place — a lit door in the gatehouse front (TAP_DOOR, drawTapDoor). tapOpen() opens sunDown-3 floored at TAP_EARLIEST, shuts by the CLOCK at 03.00 (winter's evening is longest); tapF() is the 0..1 draws mix on. probes/evening-door.mjs

callIn(a,pts,dur…) — the ONE re-route onto TAP_SLOTS, priced by pathHours()/tapFits() against TAP_SHUT. Sources: tapCallers() on market days (last stall's trader, an evening sweeper eve:true); the audience's a.toTap is priced OUT. scarcity = agents.length − tapNow. probes/tap-callers.mjs
street: cross street with two footways, roadway, curbs, lamps, four street trees in pits (TREE_PITS, drawLaneTree); allotment block of 17 plots, timber fence, gates, shed, an alley cut through the block
harvest cycle — harvestPlot() lifts a mature 3x2 bed whole, bAge doubles as a fallow clock, re-sown as a row under plotCrop(). census planting.harvested
spawnAllotAgent() — the allotments' own arrival source, rate on ripePlots(); gardeners leave carrying a basket (a.crop)

seasonal canopy on all 13 trees — leafOut/Fresh/Deep/Turn/Shed + leafCol() off seasonPhase, bare in winter behind drawBoughs(); leafFallF() drives falling leaves; fruit:1 trees add blossomF()/fruitF(). probes/canopy-year.mjs, year-strip.mjs

winter hardiness grain-matched to the PLOT — SPECIES.hardy:1 (cabbages), plotStands(x,y) off plotCrop(); seed() sows the block through speciesFor() so it is vegetables from t=0. probes/allot-year.mjs, allot-scatter.mjs
plaza: plaza with a fountain and a paved roundel (PATH), four tree pits, benches; quay with benches along the river

spawnEastAgent() — the east quarter's own arrival source (eastCap/eastRate, a.east, eastOpen() on daylight); enters by alley, quay head or park gate, one stop, leaves the way it came. census life.inEast

PAVING + pavingAt(x,y) — the ONE predicate naming a cell's paving (lane, bridge, cross street, mouth, plaza, quay, towpath, court), each with its crumbs line and bird box; crumbSpot() keeps three birds clear of the basin. probes/paving-places.mjs

the FOUNTAIN reads the YEAR — fountainPlay() = 1 - FOUNT_SWING*greyF(): jets, height/reach, droplets; basin via riverCol() + fountainIce() below FOUNT_ICE; fountainStand() sets the bench/fountain split in both spawners. probes/fountain-year.mjs

wind on the plaza: windF() 0..1 beside isWindy(); fountain jets/droplets lean +x on windT with a lee spray drift, fountainStand() drops by FOUNT_WIND_SHY on windy days (bench share up, arrivals unchanged), bandstand bunting flutters. probes/fountain-wind.mjs, fountain-wind-shots.mjs
river: river, one rowboat, three-arch bridge, towpath, church with tower and nave, bandstand, four orchard trees, jetty, park gate; pigeons flush off the belfry when the bell rings, from a finite roost

byTheWater() — the ONE predicate for the three river-facing places (quay/rail, bridge deck, towpath); boatWatch() its only reader (a.watch, one glance per boat). A parapet stop mid-span (PARAPET_Y/Z) served from spawnEastAgent

the water reads the YEAR — riverRun() drives drawRiverFlow(t): drift, streak count/length, channel colour (riverCol -> RIVER_COLD/RIVER_GREEN), mid-channel width. probes/river-year.mjs, river-shots.mjs
ONE rowboat, fair-weather — boatRate() thins as the water rises (BOAT_SWING, BOAT_FLOOR), boatSpeed() takes BOAT_DRIFT of the current; its year reads as PRESENCE

the BANDSTAND has a summer concert — bandF() stages three BAND_PLAYERS and bunting up and down on ONE 0..1; isBandDay() is hash(day,617) vs bandChance() off warmth, so July plays and February does not. probes/bandstand-year.mjs, bandstand-shots.mjs

swans are a PAIR with states — s.state swim|upend|preen + s.hold; cob (swans[0]) picks the stretch, pen re-reads it every 2.5–5.5 s, 0.9-cell give-way; SWAN_UPEND/SWAN_PREEN/SWAN_BANK; drawSwan tilts on hold. probes/swan-pair.mjs

the NIGHT on the water — drawRiverLights() in the night screen pass: bar columns under RIVER_LAMPS, a moon column via moonArc(), × nightF × (1 − cloudCover()). eastOpenFor(a): a.nightRail stands at the rail's north end while tapOpen(), ONE at a time, outside eastCap. probes/river-night.mjs
sky: day/night cycle (55 s day), sun and moon arc, backdrop hills, chimney smoke, a balloon; windows keep their own hours (windowLit)

cloudCover() — one slow rate-capped scalar; fronts build over ~half a day and break after rain; sun/moon veiled, stars out. weatherComing() is the ramped rain-is-coming predicate off it, damped by daylight. isWindy() — wind days: ticker, leaf fall, smoke, sway, washing
rainFall — a 0..1 shower intensity beside the raining boolean; drops, overcast tint, pond rings, water sparkle and chimney smoke all read it

season() — the YEAR over SEASON_LEN 26 days (~24 real min), phase 0 = midwinter, anchor SEASON_START 0.25 where every seasoned term equals the constant it replaced. Readers: light, beds, trees, working day, pop caps, weather, river, allotments, fountain, snow

the weather reads the year — greyF() drives front frequency, depth and spellLen() while showerRate/showerLen/showerHard move the OPPOSITE way, so summer's rare showers are the hard ones. Rain can start in the dark. probes/weather-year.mjs
the ground reads the lid — shadowF() with shSpread()/shOffset(): cast shadows fade, widen and retract together, eight sites, blurred on the cached ground behind CAN_BLUR. probes/shadow-cover.mjs

windowLit(sa,sb) — ONE predicate for pane and LIT[] glow, hours off the dusk edge (nid): lit 0.15–2 h after dark, bedtimes spread, 5% burn through, 14% early risers. Facades CACHED; WINDOWS[] + drawLitPanes() repaint panes live. probes/windows-night.mjs

snow — snowF() turns showers to flakes past greyF 0.55; snowCover 0..1 (rate-capped, snowAt per cell, trodden kinds take less) whitens cached ground/roofs/awnings, melts as warmth lifts; census clock.snow. probes/snow-year.mjs
life: walkers with itineraries — courtyard, street, and eastern stops (plaza bench, fountain, quay rail/bench, towpath, church green, allotment plot, parapet); cafe sitters who claim a table; market and kiosk browsers; ducks, swans, butterflies, fireflies, birds, one night cat, falling leaves
clock strikes at nine and eighteen from day 2, the church bell answers; walkers look up while it rings (a.listen)
greetPass — two passing within 0.9-1.6 cells may stop and talk (a.greet, chatCool)

EVERY sitter reads the sky — SIT_REFUSE turns a seat down, skyLifts(a) gives one up off a.wary, umbrellas on their own band. Gate on what you are DOING, not a.street; a refused seat takes routeToExit(); a pair judges once (a.mate). probes/seats-out.mjs
__entities() carries role, act, watch, raindrops and per-kind extras per person, with a stable id — the seam a behaviour probe reads instead of a bespoke hook

yearBusy(ex) multiplies the DAYLIGHT term of capacity/laneCap/eastCap only (EX_COURT/EX_LANE/EX_EAST; eastCap keeps min 7). POP_FLOOR + scarcity lift the three arrival RATES only. probes/season-year.mjs

two crowds with their OWN arrival source, outside eastCount and laneCount: the concert audience (spawnConcertAgent, BAND_TICK, nine BAND_SLOTS, a.leaveAt) and the evening door (spawnTapAgent, four TAP_SLOTS, a.tap, tapServing() stops TAP_LAST h before the shut)

somebody goes HOME — HOME_DOORS (8, row 64, drawFrontDoor under a window); goHome(a) asked ONCE in stepAgent on the lane's last leg at nightF > 0.3, priced by pathHours() vs HOME_MIN/dawn edge; HOMES register read by windowLit (windowHours() the hash half): dark on the way, lit on arrival for the hash's span. probes/going-home.mjs, going-home-shots.mjs
sill: the SILL under the canvas — #plate, #daytime, #season, #ticker (an ordered queue: TICK_DWELL 2.5 real s, cap 2, follow-ons wait for lineDwell), #stats, #ctrl; hidden under 640px except during an invitation. A ResizeObserver on the frame — the sill BORROWS space with no resize event
the sill NAMES the year — seasonLabel() on seasonPhase, eight names, sectors CENTRED on their phase. probes/sill-year.mjs

the season is a BUTTON — stepSkip()/simSub()/skipEase() fast-forward the town a quarter, landing on a whole sim day, four clicks to the year; #season underlined. probes/season-skip.mjs, season-invite.mjs

the NAMING — what is under the pointer is named in the sill (borrows the ticker box; a TAP names on a phone). bSp/bSt vs bedCap, plots off plotCrop, places off pavingAt/WATERS, 13 trees hit-tested in SCREEN space vs crowns[]. NAME_SETTLE. probes/naming.mjs

THE DIORAMA IS CLICKABLE and says so once — answersTouch(x,y) is the ONE predicate, read by cursor and handler: seeds, a daisy, crumbs, a coin, a pebble. Invitations are a QUEUE, OFFERS[] of two. probes/touch-hint.mjs

the NAMING names the LIVING things — livingAt(p) hit-tests agents, dogs, ducks, swans, boat, cat in SCREEN space on the projected feet (box per pose); personName(a) says what they are doing. probes/naming.mjs §7
harness: runlog --regrade; Harness verdicts graded on commit+log (harnessTouchedSrc); crashed-worker one-retry rule (brief.retry); filmstrip AT(day,hour), night preset at midnight

openCues.note: run-loop.sh: MANAGER_GAP vs last_manager=-99 means the stall check runs before the first landed iteration regardless of the gap
bridge-end lamp reflections only show south of the deck; the deck's shadow on the water is an implicit edge worth drawing. The rowboat has no reflection after dark.
callIn: a trader from stall 0 (x 45, 19 cells nearer) would reach the door in spring/autumn too; today only warmth ≤ 0.43 market days call in
swans have no night behaviour — ducks slow at nightF > 0.6, swans keep daytime rates and never rest on the bank

drawGround() is 9.2 ms against 2.3 ms for the rest of the frame, and rebuilds ~650×/sim-day in BOTH seasons — 80% from the grass-wear line (R()<dt*2 per walker on grass, courtyard.html ~1824), 20% the light bucket. The 'cache' is repainted every few frames. Throttle wear repaints (one dirty flag per N sim-seconds, or a dirty-rect for the trodden cell) and perf.mjs should drop hard; measure with probes/ground-rebuilds.mjs + perf.mjs.

filmstrip.mjs's 0.35 s gap reads a legitimately fast sky (winter dusk daylight moves 0.04/sample, ~7 RGB) as a POP. A 'pop' gate should compare against the per-60fps-frame Δ (probes/dusk-relight-where.mjs gap 0.0167): a step is a frame far above its neighbours, not a sample far above 2.

Snowy lawn at dawn reads pale green rather than white (cover ~0.5 mixed under the dawn tint) — the snow-wear contrast is faint at the hour the brief asked for; consider a whiter SNOW_COL floor or a higher cover before dawn shots
bunting flags ~3px at 1x — flutter only reads on a contact sheet; consider larger flags

after dark the town holds 6–9 agents and under one askable leaver a night, so goHome fires ~1×/night; a night arrival source (people coming home FROM off-frame to a door) is the supply the windows are waiting for
swans rest by the bank at nightF > 0.6 (one line in updateSwans) — unprobed beyond the motion gate
row-64 windows are drawn live and then night-tinted, so a lit pane there lands at (127,118,116) — half the cached windows' warmth

watch.note: The east half is fed by ONE spawnLaneAgent roll under one laneCap (peaks at 9). Anything out there competes for that budget — check whether your feature needs its own arrival source before concluding it is unused. Bands: market 0.24, kiosk 0.18, cafe 0.26, allotment 0.48, plaza 0.48, quay 0.53, green 0.58. spawnEastAgent adds eastCap (max 7); its arrivals RETRACE their route, so a wider cap means single file.

THE NIGHT IS BUILT, NOT WIRED TO THE DAY. Windows keep hours (#39), the door (#33) has callers (#47), the river has lamps and one rail stander (#46). But nobody who leaves the frame at dusk GOES anywhere — routeToExit() walks them off; no window lights because someone came home. Plaza and church have no night at all beyond eastOpenFor.

THE YEAR IS READ EVERYWHERE BUT THE WIND IS READ NOWHERE EAST OF THE BRIDGE — isWindy() moves washing, smoke, leaves and sway on the lane; the fountain, the river, the bandstand bunting and the far bank ignore it. Snow whitens the ground but nothing walks through it differently (snowAt already takes less on trodden kinds — build on that, not beside it).

The observer tools are all advertised now: naming, the season label, the season button, and OFFERS[] which spent its second offer at #31. A NEW one joins that queue; it does not get a hint of its own.
